description: Create a navigable case management manual. Open '/home/ga/Documents/case_manual_draft.docx', which contains 8 chapters. You must: (1) Insert a Bookmark at the start of each of the 8 chapter headings (e.g., 'Chapter 1: Intake...', 'Chapter 2: Service Planning...', etc.). (2) Insert a new page at the very beginning of the document with the title 'Quick Navigation'. (3) On this new page, list the 8 chapter titles and convert each one into a Hyperlink that points to the corresponding bookmark you created (Document/Internal link, not a web URL). (4) Save the document as '/home/ga/Documents/case_manual_navigable.docx'.
